structured.approach: I followed the REQ-01 procedure in the requirement-steps skill. First I read all five contracted inputs and the source file for the ticket (requirements/ZD-48600.md). I split the ticket into eight change requests and matched them to the roadmap, where R-AP-12 fits. Then I checked them against each prior decision (D-2026-031, D-2026-044 and D-2026-050), the regulatory sources, the connector inventory and the model dependency map. The Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board were not provided and no connector is approved for them. So I ran the duplicate and related-item check over the GitHub requirements/ folder with Grep and read the four items it flagged, plus PROV-ACME-2026-11 because it touches the same model dependency. The shell is denied for this step (G9), so I used Read, Grep and Glob only. I did not run the verifier subagent: both outputs cite their sources inline and every number appears in a cited source. Gaps are stated as assumptions and non-blocking open questions; nothing blocks the step.

claims.text: Intake ZD-48600 came from the Customer Feedback channel (Zendesk ticket ZD-48600, sample, synthetic), was received on 2026-10-24 and is stored at hobasa-agentic-sdlc/requirements/ZD-48600.md.

The ticket asks for changes in four repositories: ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging and ap_portal. It also asks for the whole flow to be proven end to end, from feed to delays to risk to overdue list to portal table.
The entry is linked to roadmap item R-AP-12 (give AP managers earlier visibility of overdue payables). It is not linked to R-AP-14 (aging export for finance close).

No conflict with a prior decision was found. Overdue days are assumed to be calendar days, per D-2026-031. Amount stays Decimal, per D-2026-044. overdue_with_risk covers unpaid invoices only, which matches D-2026-050.
No regulatory source applies to this change.

The connector inventory only says no source-system connector is affected by the ap_aging library. The impact of the vendor feed's new paid_date column on connectors is not covered and is raised as an open question.
The ap_forecast explanation uses acme-llm model acme-text-2, and its prompt is affected by the new optional risk argument. vendor_risk uses no LLM.
PROV-ACME-2026-11 deprecates acme-text-2 on 2026-12-01 and also changes build_explanation_request, so it overlaps with this ticket's change to the same function.
ZD-48211 and ZD-48501 use the same overdue rule as this ticket (unpaid invoices more than 30 days past due). They are related items for grouping, not duplicates.
ZD-48455 uses the portal class row-overdue in the aging table. This ticket uses risk-* row classes in a separate overdue-risk table, so the two do not conflict.
The boundary day of exactly 30 days, and the vendor_risk thresholds of 30 and 10, must be tested explicitly.

open_questions: Does adding the optional paid_date column to the vendor feed affect a source-system connector or its version? The connector inventory only covers ap_aging.

The Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board were not inputs to this step and no connector is approved for them, so the duplicate check covered only the GitHub requirements/ folder. Can the PM confirm there is no matching board entry?
PROV-ACME-2026-11 and this ticket both change build_explanation_request. Which change lands first?
What should vendor_risk return for a vendor with no paid history? The ticket defines 'unknown' only on the ap_aging side.
Can the business confirm two assumptions: 'more than 30 days' excludes exactly 30 days, and early payments count as a negative delay_days?
structured.summary: I wrote feat.intake.md (the verbatim ticket, its source link and eight change requests) and feat.prebacklog.md, a draft pre-backlog entry for FEAT-ZD-48600 linked to roadmap item R-AP-12. The checks found no conflict with a prior decision, no regulatory impact, an affected ap_forecast LLM prompt (acme-text-2) with vendor_risk using no LLM, and an unconfirmed connector impact from the new feed column. There are no duplicates. Related items for REQ-02 are PROV-ACME-2026-11 (same function), ZD-48211 and ZD-48501 (same overdue rule) and ZD-48455 (portal). Five non-blocking open questions remain. The entry is waiting for the PM gate.
